punk.name: Punk Hazard
punk.description: One side is continuously burned; the other is continuously chilled.

budokai.name: Tenkaichi Budokai
budokai.description: The first five slots fight simultaneous one-on-one duels. Win three duels to win.

dangai.name: Dangai
dangai.description: The Kōtotsu sweeps through every five seconds, dealing 20% of maximum HP to every unit.

valley.name: Valley of the End
valley.description: Each team’s strongest member, measured by modified starting stats, fights a deciding duel.

colosseum.name: Colosseum
colosseum.description: After six seconds, Silver Chariot Requiem shuffles positions within and between teams. Original teams return after battle.

hope.name: Hope’s Peak Academy
hope.description: The first unit to kill another unit is immediately executed.

itomori.name: Itomori
itomori.description: Tiamat strikes after 20 seconds. The team with the greater sum of remaining HP percentages wins. Ties favor your team.

morioh.name: Morioh
morioh.description: A murderer eliminates one random character from each team quietly.

hell.name: Hell
hell.description: Doors cover the sky. The Darkness Devil has a chance to appear, to damage all units and inflict WEAKENED.

infinite_castle.name: Infinite Castle
infinite_castle.description: A biwa strums every eight seconds, splitting combatants into isolated room matchups.

inaba.name: Inaba
inaba.description: A dense fog shrouds the identity and abilities of opponent lineups until battle commences.

tracen.name: Tracen Academy
tracen.description: Umamusume from Tracen Academy unleash unpredictable shenanigans periodically.

alcatraz.name: Alcatraz Tower
alcatraz.description: Duelists are elevated to the summit in a chaotic Battle Royale where every unit attacks friend and foe.

axis.name: Axis
axis.description: Caught in a war, both sides are reinforced by mobile suit pilots and commanders.

tootsuki.name: Totsuki Culinary Academy
tootsuki.description: Every six seconds, a Shokugeki occurs and the most injured unit eats the dish to recover 30% HP.
